verdict: Not ready to merge. One stated contract contradicts the source facts, and several prerequisites for installed-package discovery are assumed but not yet shown to hold. Most of the rest matches the source facts. Plain Markdown discovery is enough for a controlled trial once the probe passes; no CLI or MCP tooling is needed yet. The probe has not reported results, so nothing below counts as verified.
blockingIssues: api.md, Events and cleanup: 'A retained Application listening to replaceable feature Views therefore releases those subscriptions when the Views are destroyed' contradicts the sentence before it and the source fact that destroying a View does not off incoming subscriptions. The retained Application keeps those subscriptions until it calls stopListening(view) itself or is destroyed. Stop also keeps generic listenTo. Rewrite it to say the Application must call stopListening(view) when the View is replaced or closed. Then check that the records example's showList listenTo(page, {...}) is actually released on close/reopen. If it is not, this is a product (example) bug, not just a docs bug.

Installed-package links: readme.md links to ../examples/records/src/main.js and ../examples/records/README.md, and api.md links to ../examples/records/src/setup.js. These resolve only if the tarball's `files` includes examples/records at that relative path. readme.md, llms.txt and quick-start also link records.md and architecture.md, which are not in this change set. Confirm with `npm pack --dry-run` or the probe's link-following that every relative link resolves inside the installed package. Otherwise drop the links or ship the files.

Discovery command: `node -p "require.resolve('marionette/package.json')"` throws ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED if the package `exports` map does not expose './package.json'. Confirm the export exists, or document a resolution path that works.

Installed README entry point: the probe follows docs 'from installed README', but README.md is not in the changed files. Confirm the packaged README.md links to docs/readme.md and llms.txt. Also confirm llms.txt and docs/ are in package `files`.
risks: All five files hardcode 5.0.0-rc.2. If the candidate tarball's package.json version differs, the docs misstate their own version. Check it in the probe.

quick-start installs marionette@5.0.0-rc.2 from the registry, but setup.md says registry availability is unverified. 'Install its supplied tarballs in place of the registry package versions' does not show the command. Give the literal `npm install --save-exact ./marionette-5.0.0-rc.2.tgz ./mnjs-adapters-5.0.0-rc.2.tgz` form, or state that the registry commands will not work until publication.
The pinned vite@8.3.0 and lit-html@3.3.3 must exist and support Node 24. The probe installs from locked tarballs, so it may never exercise these exact third-party pins. Verify with `npm view`.
Merging this to master while the production docs pipeline depends on deleted docs will break releases. Keep it on a branch, or disable or guard the pipeline in the same PR.

The quick start configures no DataApi. With Backbone optional in v5, confirm that constructing a View without a DataApi, and without Backbone installed, does not throw or warn. The 3 quick-start browser smoke checks should cover this with Backbone absent.

These claims are not covered by the supplied source facts: Model.reset reapplies defaults; Collection.get accepts a client ID or a Model; render() resets Regions and destroys their children; showView works while stopped; stateEvents keep delivering during pending stop preparation; triggers prevent default and stop propagation by default. Each needs a source or test citation, or should be removed.

setup.md says 'Marionette disposes state created by createState' outright, while api.md makes that conditional on StateApi.disposeOwned. This is only accurate if @mnjs/data's StateApi implements disposeOwned. Confirm, or make the wording conditional.
api.md does not say what a repeated active start with a different Region does: reject, resolve false, or throw. Agents will guess.
incorrectAssumptions: That passing the 48 unchanged browser checks shows the docs are correct. Those checks test the example, not the prose. Contract claims need their own evidence, as the caller already noted.

That link-following from README and llms.txt covers the ../examples links. That holds only if the probe follows every relative link, including parent-directory links, against the installed tree rather than the checkout.

setup.md's 'The runnable example uses local packages from this repository' assumes the reader is in the checkout. That is wrong for someone reading the installed package, which is the stated discovery path.
missingTests: A link checker run over the installed package directory (not the checkout) that fails on any unresolved relative link in docs/*.md, llms.txt or README.md.
Run the discovery command in an installed project with type=module and assert the path it prints has docs/readme.md beside it.
Assert that the version in each doc equals the packed package.json version.

A test for the Application-listens-to-replaceable-View case: after closing and reopening records, events from the old PageView or feature View no longer reach Application handlers, and the listener count does not grow.
Run the quick start with Backbone absent and no DataApi set.
Unit-level tests or citations for Model.reset with defaults, Collection.get with a client ID or Model, and a repeated start with a different Region.
`npm view vite@8.3.0` and `npm view lit-html@3.3.3` existence checks, or a quick-start install that resolves those pins from the registry.
simplifications: Remove the duplicate install block in setup.md, which is also inconsistent: it omits --save-exact. Point to quick-start for installation and list only the extra @mnjs/data package.
Put the prerelease and registry caveat in one place, readme.md, instead of repeating it in quick-start and setup.
Drop the checkout-oriented wording in setup.md ('local packages from this repository', 'verified local example workflow'). The docs should read correctly from inside the installed package.
llms.txt can list only readme.md plus the two references. The index already links the lessons, and listing six entries duplicates the navigation.
nextSteps: Fix the api.md cleanup sentence and check the records example's Application→View subscriptions on close/reopen.
Run `npm pack --dry-run` and confirm that docs/, llms.txt, README.md, the examples/records paths, records.md and architecture.md are all present, and that `exports` exposes ./package.json.
Let the probe finish. Add installed-tree link checking, a version-equality check and a Backbone-absent quick-start check before claiming results.
Cite or cut the unverified data and lifecycle claims listed under risks.
Keep this off master until the production docs pipeline is guarded. Then proceed to the controlled trial with Markdown-only discovery.
